reports.notes:
While tying both 18-inch outlet pipes into the outlet box, an elevation discrepancy was identified. The south outlet pipe is approximately 6 inches higher than the specified elevation at the outlet box.
EFI was on site to review the issue and develop a corrective plan. EFI will cut the existing liner around the south outlet pipe, Bennett will excavate from the outlet box back to the south outlet pipe to achieve the required elevation, and EFI will weld a new boot connection around the pipe. The area will then be backfilled.
This repair will not interrupt feeding operations to either lagoon.

A major electrical issue occurred on the dairy side when the service pole connection to the main transformer disconnect completely melted, causing the lagoon feed pumps to shut down. A backup plan was implemented using a generator to power the pumps. The pumps are currently operating at a steady pace at 45 Hz.
